calibration.name: Baseline timing jitter (ms)
calibration.source: within-neuron value used between areas: precision of rate modulation in macaque MT in vivo, Buracas et al. (1998); swept 1-10

calibration.name: Integration window W (ms)
calibration.source: within-cell windows used between areas: 1-10 ms in rodent barrel cortex, Gabernet et al. (2005); under 2 ms in hippocampus, Pouille and Scanziani (2001); swept 1-10

calibration.name: Oscillation frequency (Hz)
calibration.source: within the gamma band, Fries (2015); Llinás and Ribary (1993)

calibration.name: Oscillator feedback λ
calibration.source: calibration to ratio 1.08 failed: inertia within noise

calibration.name: Arousal level
calibration.source: inertia ratios 1.07-1.63 reproduced at every level tested

calibration.name: Fallback reference rate, P8 (Hz)
calibration.source: centre of the measured frontal alpha band, 8-12 Hz, Purdon et al. (2013)

calibration.name: GABAergic-like agent
calibration.source: maximal failure swept 0.6-0.95; failure at loss of quorum compared with 62% inhibition of glutamate release by 0.7 mM isoflurane (about 2 MAC) in cultured rat hippocampal neurons, Baumgart et al. (2015)

calibration.name: NMDA-antagonist-like agent
calibration.source: maximal effects not measurable at this scale
